graph.title: Tractor (LEGO City 7634)

new_part_types.name: Technic angle connector with axle hole (black)
Axle plate 2x4 with axle ends (black, front axle)

notes: Page images are low resolution. Piece identities come from the inventory (pp. 20-21), but where each piece sits is partly inferred from the step pictures. Joins between specific beams, plates and bricks, and the port names on them, are approximate.

L3 (two separate groups) is not a real problem here. Page 3 builds the farmer minifigure (b1-b5: cap, head, torso, legs, shovel) as its own model. Pages 4-19 build the tractor and tipper trailer. The minifig is never attached to the tractor; he only stands beside it in the last picture. The two groups are kept separate on purpose.
Inventory ids 362301 and 306926 look like OCR variants of 302301 (white plate 1x2) and the black 1x2 tile. 362301 is mapped to catalogue lego-302301.

The minifig legs (element 74040) use catalogue type lego-legs-green. The steering wheel on its white 1x2 plate (element 9551) uses the catalogue steering-wheel type lego-3829 (a real part number). The plate and wheel are treated as one piece, joined by its anti-stud.
Steps 3-4: the plates under the beams (b6, b9, b10) are read as attached to the underside of the two 1x12 beams, because step 3 is drawn flipped.

Steps 8-10: red brackets A and B each carry a black ladder slope. A also carries the clip plate, which holds the exhaust rod, and the 1x4 plate sub-assembly. Bracket C at the front carries the headlight lens plate with two round headlights and the printed black tile.
The 2x2 bricks and grille bricks sit on the beams or front bracket; their exact positions are inferred.
Step 17: the inventory lists two windscreens, so both are modelled, one on each red 1x6 plate. The roof 4193074 sits on both and on the hinge plate 4140585.
Step 14: the wheat-print piece is read as 241221 on a red 2x2 brick.
Trailer (p.16): the blue pins go through the 2x2 plate's hole, a black arm goes on each blue pin, and the tipper bucket sits on top. In step 19 the arms plug into the rear angle connectors b18/b19.
Where several things join one catalogue port, joins were spread over different ports, or replaced by contact edges (the red 1x6 plates touch the rear plate b17).
Tyre-to-rim joins use a ball/socket pairing to fit the allowed port kinds. No electrical parts.

graph_initial.title: Tractor (LEGO City 7634)

new_part_types.name: Technic angle connector with axle hole (black)
Axle plate 2x4 with axle ends (black, front axle)

notes: Page images are low resolution; piece identities come from the inventory (pp. 20-21) but where each piece sits is partly inferred from the step pictures. Joins between specific beams, plates and bricks are approximate, and the port names used on some joins are best guesses.
The inventory shows 362301 and 306926, which look like OCR variants of 302301 (white plate 1x2) and 3069/306926 (black tile 1x2). I mapped 362301 to the catalogue type lego-302301.
Steps 3 and 4: the plates under the beams (b6, b9, b10) are read as attached to the underside of the two 1x12 beams, because step 3 is drawn flipped.

Steps 8-9: the three red brackets are A (step 8, with ladder slope 1 and a clip plate), B (step 9, with ladder slope 2) and C (step 10, at the front with the lens plate and two headlights). I read the step 9 ladder as going on a second bracket B.
Step 14 places a wheat-print piece; I read it as 241221 on the red brick b35. Step 21 puts the 306926 black printed tile on the front bracket.
Step 17: the inventory lists two windscreens (4543458 x2), so both are modelled, attached to the red 1x6 plates. The roof 4193074 sits on them and on the hinge plate 4140585.
Page 13 sub-assembly (plate 1x4 + black 1x2 plate + grille) is attached to bracket A. The exhaust rod b51 is held in the clip plate b23.
Trailer sub-assembly (p.16): the 2x2 plate with pin hole carries two blue pins and two black arms, then the tipper bucket. The arms are plugged into the rear angle connectors b18/b19 in step 19.
The rear axle 4211805 goes through both 1x2 Technic bricks b14 and b15, with the large rims and tyres on its ends. The front small rims go on the ends of the front axle plate 4217725.
No electrical parts; only joined and contact edges are used.

final_issue_list: the build is 2 separate groups of pieces; connect them unless the booklet really builds separate models
